einzeiler: Comparing Sandals Ochi and Sandals Negril to help you choose the best Jamaica resort.
kurzfassung: The hosts compare Sandals Ochi and Sandals Negril in Jamaica, analyzing differences in size, rooms, dining, pools, beaches, activities, and pricing. Sandals Ochi is much larger with more dining and pool options, whereas Sandals Negril focuses on a relaxed atmosphere and Seven Mile Beach. Ultimately, the choice depends on personal travel style and whether you prioritize pools or beach access.
stichpunkte: Sandals Ochi is the largest Sandals property with 515 rooms spread across hillside and beachside areas.
Sandals Negril features 244 rooms, offering a more compact, flat layout directly on Seven Mile Beach.
Sandals Ochi offers 16 restaurants and 11 bars, including a speakeasy called the Rabbit Hole.
Sandals Negril has 9 restaurants and 6 bars, prioritizing traditional Sandals dining options and open-air layouts.
Sandals Negril excels with its beach access and consistency in room quality, while Ochi wins on pool variety.
Club Mobay offers a newly renovated VIP arrival and departure lounge at Montego Bay airport.
Sandals Ochi lead-in rooms start around $291 per person per night, compared to $368 at Sandals Negril for May 2027.
